```sql
with fx as (
    select rate_date, aud_nzd_rate
    from staging.stg_erp__fx_rates
),
material_categories as (
    select sku, product_category
    from staging.stg_erp__materials
    where sku is not null
),
pos_rev as (
    select
        m.product_category,
        sum(p.line_total * case when p.currency = 'AUD' then coalesce(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0) else 1.0 end) as rev
    from staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines p
    join staging.stg_erp__stores s on p.store_id = s.store_id
    left fx f on p.txn_date = f.rate_date
    join material_categories m on p.sku = m.sku
    where p.txn_date >= '2025-12-01' and p.txn_date <= '2025-12-31'
      and p.txn_type = 'SALE'
      and p.is_valid = true
    group by 1
),
ecom_rev as (
    select
        m.product_category,
        sum((ol.line_total - coalesce(ol.discount_amount, 0)) * case when o.currency = 'AUD' then coalesce(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0) else 1.0 end) as rev
    from staging.stg_ecom__order_lines ol
    join staging.stg_ecom__orders o on ol.order_id = o.order_id
    left fx f on o.order_date = f.rate_date
    join material_categories m on ol.sku = m.sku
    where o.order_date >= '2025-12-01' and o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
      and o.order_status != 'Cancelled'
    group by 1
),
erp_rev as (
    select
        m.product_category,
        sum(sol.net_value * case when sol.currency = 'AUD' then coalesce(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0) else 1.0 end) as rev
    from staging.stg_erp__sales_order_lines sol
    left fx f on sol.order_date = f.rate_date
    join staging.stg_erp__materials m on sol.material_id = m.material_id
    where sol.order_date >= '2025-12-01' and sol.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
    group by 1
),
combined as (
    select product_category, rev from pos_rev
    union all
    select product_category, rev from ecom_rev
    union all
    select product_category, rev from erp_rev
)
select product_category as answer
from combined
group by 1
order by sum(rev) desc
limit 1;
```
